questions.q: In the point (3, 4), the x-coordinate is ____.
questions.explanation: The first number of the ordered pair is the x-coordinate.

questions.q: What are the coordinates of the origin?
questions.explanation: The origin is where the two axes meet.

questions.q: Which graph is best for showing change over time?
questions.explanation: A line graph shows trends over time.

questions.q: A point on the x-axis has y-coordinate ____.
questions.explanation: Every point on the x-axis has the form (x, 0).

questions.q: The horizontal axis of a graph is called the ____.
questions.explanation: The x-axis runs left to right.
